subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which linked branch or replacement should own the remaining Mattermost cron/non-direct delivery-context repair after the message-tool subcase shipped?
rationale: The issue is still valid, but the central message-tool symptom is already fixed while the remaining cron/heartbeat scope overlaps stale or risky open PRs that need a human choice before automation starts another fix lane.

options.title: Adopt or replace the delivery-context fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77442 or a narrow replacement as the canonical path for persisting non-direct Mattermost delivery context, then close this issue after merge and proof.

options.title: Keep only the issue open
options.body: Close or leave aside stale message-tool-only branches such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/52120, and keep this issue as the remaining cron/heartbeat tracker until a fresh candidate appears.

options.title: Request live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer or contributor supplies redacted live Mattermost cron/wake proof that isolates the current release behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the delivery-context fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77442 or a narrow replacement as the canonical path for persisting non-direct Mattermost delivery context, then close this issue after merge and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored shared outbound follow-up commits in the merged replacement and have recent Mattermost/session delivery maintenance context.
